name: Quilter plc
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from Quilter plc half year results 2026 condensed consolidated statement of comprehensive income, period ended 30 June 2026, unit GBP million stored in absolute pounds. Total income 6685 is the printed revenue line on the same basis as the stored FY2025 column, which also carries total income including policyholder investment return. Total expenses 6463 are the printed expense lines; the separately printed finance costs of 10 sit in Net Finance Costs, so Operating Expenses are 6453 and Revenue less Operating Expenses equals EBIT 232. EBIT less Net Finance Costs equals the printed profit before tax 222. Income tax 177 is policyholder tax 162 plus shareholder tax 15, and 222 less 177 equals the printed profit after tax attributable to the owners of the Company 45. Basic EPS 3.3 pence. Source https://plc.quilter.com/4a1feb/siteassets/documents/stock-exchange-announcements/quilter-plc-half-year-results-2026.pdf || CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard).
